breaking.h: Astronomers discover a dead star spinning every 8 minutes and sending mysterious radio pulses
breaking.t: Scientists have discovered a strange stellar pair more than 5,000 light-years away, where a dead star spinning every eight minutes produces mysterious radio pulses while orbiting a Sun-like star.

stories.h: Tangled quantum whirlpools caught unraveling in an ultracold gas
stories.t: When a cloud of atoms is cooled close to absolute zero, its atoms can merge into a Bose–Einstein condensate (BEC): an exotic fluid in which atoms across the whole cloud share a single quantum state.

stories.h: Rachelle Hampton won’t admit how long she spent charting the use of ‘murmur’ in Twilight
stories.t: Rachelle Hampton is a writer and co-owner at Defector Media, and the host of Normal Gossip, a podcast of anonymous listener-submitted stories about everyday drama.

stories.h: On this day in space! Nov. 15, 1988: The 300-foot Green Bank Telescope collapses suddenly, leaving a huge pile of wreckage in West Virginia
stories.t: On Nov. 15, 1988, a 300-foot radio telescope in Green Bank, West Virginia suddenly collapsed. Here's why it mattered.

stories.h: Vitamin C could help block cancer-linked chemicals in your stomach, study finds
stories.t: Scientists have discovered that vitamin C may help prevent potentially cancer-causing chemicals from forming in the stomach after eating foods containing nitrates and nitrites.
